style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, dry deadpan satire, vertical 9:16 frame, taller than wide
motion_rule: the cart rolls all clip and never stops; the stall row blows across frame every beat; ONE sideways move per beat, never chained; new shot size each beat; her muzzle never under a third of frame, jaw visible; motion across frame only, never up or down
character: a wiry macaque in a grey waistcoat on the rolling cart deck, exactly two arms, muzzle and jaw clear
second_characters: ONE rat porter on the deck a shoulder from the lens, working on the move, crossing frame every beat
props: ONE brass balance on a post bolted to the deck, two identical pans; ONE red sack and ONE blue sack, same cloth and size; A SWARM of paper slips in ONE crate; ONE batten
prop_continuity: the balance rides at her muzzle, the sacks stay seated in their pans, only slips spill
environment: a packed market lane, stalls both sides, a porters' cart rolling down the middle, shoppers diving clear
light_events: white noon, a hard rim on her muzzle and the flying slips

audio.delivery: a level pleased female voice, biting off each word, even 4.35 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: KRAS-nyy, me-SHOK, SI-niy, TO-zhe, STREL-ka, RO-vno, vli-TA-ya, ba-LANS, so-SHOL-sya, o-BE-ikh, sto-RON, dol-GI
audio.pacing: speech runs unbroken 0.00 to 7.75, first word at 0.00, no gap between beats; her voice is finished at 7.75, from there wheels, crowd and paper fill the track wall to wall to 10.00
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: wheels on stones all clip, market roar, paper flapping

timeline.a: she hurls the red sack across frame into the near pan, the rat rolling his crate across frame at the lens, not touching her
she swings the blue sack across frame into the far pan, the pans levelling
the rat hauls his batten across frame at the lens and she rocks aside
she slaps the beam across frame, both pans riding level past the lens
the rat swings across frame under the beam and shoulders into her side
she goes hand over hand along the post across frame, post and pans rolling with her
she snatches an armful of slips out of the crate across frame, paper streaming behind
the rat dumps his crate across frame into the near pan and she flings her armful into the far pan, both level
she throws herself sideways across the deck under the heaped pans, the cart picking up speed
the rat shoves the emptied crate onto her tail and she walks the deck across frame dragging both after her
she walks the deck across frame and shoulders both pans over, a storm of slips, the rat at the lens
she dives muzzle first at the lens through falling paper, jaw open, both heaped pans level at both frame edges

must_appear: rolling deck and fleeing stall row every beat; the red sack in the near pan from 1.15, the blue in the far pan from 2.05; the pans level from 2.75 and level again at 9.30; at 9.30 her muzzle on the lens, jaw open, both pans heaped with identical slips at both frame edges; every word spoken, the last by 7.75
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal frame, a static camera, a still background, a parked cart, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero moving up or down the frame, standing bystanders, slow motion, letters, writing, digits, a word not in the lines, a closed jaw while speaking, extra limbs, a third arm, multiple monkeys, duplicate props, a balance off its post, foreign accent
